Scales for rink heatmaps

Source: R/scales.R
scale_rink.Rd

Matched scales for the geom_rink_bin() styles:

scale_fill_rink()

Sequential fill for the cell mean, labelled Low / High at the ends by default. Used by every style.

scale_fill_rink_diverging()

Diverging fill centred on 0, for maps of differences. Limits are symmetric around 0 (from the data unless you pass limits), so 0 sits at the neutral midpoint.

scale_size_rink()

Event-count size scale for style = "size". Square sides are set in rink units as a fraction of binwidth, so the largest square fills a cell and the smallest stays legible.

scale_alpha_rink()

Event-count alpha scale for style = "alpha".

Fill limits are yours to choose: the default NULL uses the range of the data, which changes from plot to plot. Fix limits (values outside are squished to the ends) when several maps should share one colour key.

Usage

scale_fill_rink(
  name = "Value",
  palette = "Viridis",
  limits = NULL,
  breaks = function(lims) lims,
  labels = c("Low", "High"),
  ...
)

scale_fill_rink_diverging(
  name = "Difference",
  palette = "Blue-Red 3",
  limits = NULL,
  breaks = function(lims) c(lims[1], 0, lims[2]),
  labels = c("Below", "0", "Above"),
  ...
)

scale_size_rink(
  name = "Count",
  binwidth = 2.5,
  frac = c(0.4, 1),
  square_colour = "#143F84",
  ...
)

scale_alpha_rink(
  name = "Count",
  range = c(0.15, 1),
  square_colour = "#143F84",
  ...
)

Arguments

name

Legend title.

palette

A grDevices::hcl.colors() palette name (see grDevices::hcl.pals()), e.g. "Viridis", "Mako" or "Rocket" for the sequential scale and "Blue-Red 3", "Vik" or "Purple-Green" for the diverging one; or a vector of colours.

limits

Fill limits. For scale_fill_rink_diverging(), NULL derives symmetric limits c(-a, a) from the data.

breaks, labels

Passed to the underlying scale. The defaults label only the ends of the bar (and 0 for the diverging scale); use e.g. breaks = waiver(), labels = waiver() for numeric labels.

...

Passed to the underlying ggplot2 scale.

binwidth

The binwidth given to geom_rink_bin(). Square sides range over frac * binwidth.

frac

Smallest and largest square side, as a fraction of binwidth. The largest is capped at 1 (one full cell) so squares never overlap.

square_colour

Fill colour of the legend squares.

range

Smallest and largest alpha.

Value

A ggplot2 scale.

See also

geom_rink_bin()

Examples

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(shots, aes(x, y, z = xg)) +
  annotate_rink(zones = "oz") +
  geom_rink_bin(binwidth = 2, scales = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_rink(name = "Mean xG", palette = "Rocket", limits = c(0, 0.25),
                  breaks = waiver(), labels = waiver()) +
  scale_size_rink(name = "Shots", binwidth = 2)
